Tax is configured per **region**, and a region is a country you have registered in. Within it, rates are a **component vector** rather than one number, because a single sale can attract several taxes at once that must appear separately on the invoice.

A **tax profile** applies one class of rate to one class of product, so reduced-rate and standard-rate goods can sit in the same catalogue. Where a sale is taxed depends on the place of supply — the buyer's address against the seller's registrations — so state registrations are held per region and snapshotted onto each invoice. A region can be priced tax-inclusive, in which case the tax is backed out of the price rather than added to it.

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/tax_profiles`](/help/developers/api-reference/tax/list-tax-profiles) | List tax profiles |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/tax_profiles`](/help/developers/api-reference/tax/create-a-tax-profile) | Create a tax profile |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/tax_regions`](/help/developers/api-reference/tax/list-tax-regions-with-their-components-and-state) | List tax regions with their components and state registrations |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/tax_regions`](/help/developers/api-reference/tax/configure-a-country-as-a-taxable-region) | Configure a country as a taxable region |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/tax_regions/{txg}`](/help/developers/api-reference/tax/retrieve-one-tax-region) | Retrieve one tax region |
| `PATCH` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/tax_regions/{txg}`](/help/developers/api-reference/tax/edit-a-region) | Edit a region |
| `DELETE` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/tax_regions/{txg}`](/help/developers/api-reference/tax/archive-a-tax-region) | Archive a tax region |
| `PUT` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/tax_regions/{txg}/components`](/help/developers/api-reference/tax/replace-one-state-scope-s-tax-component-vector) | Replace one state scope's tax component vector |
| `PUT` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/tax_regions/{txg}/state_registrations`](/help/developers/api-reference/tax/upsert-the-seller-s-registration-in-one-state) | Upsert the seller's registration in one state |
| `DELETE` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/tax_regions/{txg}/state_registrations/{txs}`](/help/developers/api-reference/tax/delete-a-state-s-seller-registration) | Delete a state's seller registration |
